tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Liability law could force firms to prioritize public safety, argues Robert Reich in Still open per The Guardian. The approach targets both artificial intelligence and fossil fuel companies facing existential risks.
DeepSeek launches V4.1-Flash with 552B parameters and reduced memory costs, reported by Bénin Web TV. The new multimodal model expands the company's offerings.
OpenAI dismisses three safety researchers amid claims of retaliation and lack of transparency, reported by Analytics Insight. The dismissals cite policy breaches.
Elastic's AlertZero cuts SOC alert overload with artificial intelligence-driven triage and analysis, reported by 디지털투데이. The tool helps security teams manage volume.
Anthropic's new policy on user behavior toward Claude shapes how people interact with the model, reported by Firstpost. The guidelines set expectations for respectful engagement.
Free every hour.
